You are expected to file the clerk’s record by the original due date. See Tex. R. App. P. 35. If
it is determined that the due date may not be met, please advise the Clerk of this Court immediately
in writing, stating the reason and the due date by which the record will be filed. Generally
speaking, for good cause shown, the Court will grant no more than two extensions from the original
record due date, each extension not to exceed 30 days in regular appeals and 10 days in accelerated
appeals for a total period not to exceed 60 days in regular appeals and 20 days in accelerated
appeals. See Tex. R. App. P. 35.3(c).
